cohort: The study included 102,169 deliveries assisted in Malaga University Hospital (Malaga, Andalusia, Spain) between 1998 and 2015.
finding: A significant shortening of the duration of pregnancy was observed in the course of the study period, with a mean gestational age at delivery of 269 days.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 269 days (SD 16 days), with a modal gestational age of 273 days; mean duration for singleton pregnancies was 271 days and for multiple pregnancies was 242 days.
